:::{#def-polynomial-leading-coefficient}
#### Leading coefficient

Let $f(x) = a_n x^n + \cdots + a_1 x + a_0$
be a [polynomial](#def-polynomial) of [degree](#def-polynomial-degree) $n$.
The constant $a_n$ is the **leading coefficient** of $f$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-leading-coefficient}
#### Leading coefficients

- $f(x) = 5 - 2x^2 + x^3$ has degree $3$,
  so its leading coefficient is $a_3 = 1$,
  not the $5$ written first.
- $f(x) = 3 - x^2$ has leading coefficient $a_2 = -1$.

:::
